input.prompt: Speak as a warm, conversational Turkish narrator addressing one curious listener. Let short reveal sentences land, then slow slightly for explanation. Use clear Istanbul Turkish diction and natural pauses. Avoid sermon, classroom lecture, documentary-announcer delivery, exaggerated drama, and a repeated rhetorical rise-and-fall. Do not give every section the same cadence.
